record.question: When assessing 4 month old infant, he is not able to breastfeed and chest indrawing is present. As per IMNCI the child will be classified as having:
record.explanation: Answer D: Severe pneumonia. For children aged 2 months to 5 years, inability to breastfeed/drink is a general danger sign in IMNCI; this is not the “young infant” (<2 months) algorithm. In a 4-month-old, the danger sign supports severe pneumonia/severe disease classification and urgent referral. Reference: https://nhm.gov.in/New_Updates_2018/NHM_Components/RMNCH_MH_Guidelines/IMNCI_Chart_Booklet.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
